# Waveform Catalogue

Every waveform currently registered with `ripplegw.waveform(...)`. Construct any of them by name: `ripplegw.waveform("<Name>", **config)`. See [Working with Waveforms](waveforms.md) for the calling convention and [Parameters and Conventions](parameters.md) for what each parameter means.
